pages.text: The Catalyst, the "seeder" of crystal automation: burns energy to grow akaishi clusters on geodes in range.$(li)Basic: 3×3×3, 20% success, 5 energy/t$(li)Intermediate: 5×5×5, 30% success, 25 energy/t$(li)Advanced: 9×9×9, 40% success, 125 energy/t$(li)Ultimate: 16×16×16, 50% success, 625 energy/t$(br2)Bigger is stronger, but the power bill grows too — pace yourself.
Geodes come in 4 grades: flawed / normal / intact / pristine, and they're the bed where clusters grow.$(br)Catalyst plants, Collector reaps, and you get to lie back and count crystals.
